source_inventory.scope: names and file sizes only; this is not source qualification

admission.reason: free space is already below the fixed reserve before an isolated copy or any compactor working files are created

measurement.reason: the frozen admission rule blocks the run before copying or compaction

storage_authority.note: remote build storage does not replace the local compactor reserve

remaining_requirements: recheck current local free space after the existing storage manager finishes eligible recovery
create an isolated copy only when the full admission calculation passes without lowering the reserve
run the bounded compactor on that copy and record source/compact parity, actual output bytes, peak memory and wall time
obtain separate review before any cleanup activation
